chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā narrated from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from his father, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who leaves the Friday ghusl, forgetfully or otherwise. He said: “If he was forgetful, then his salat is complete. But if he did so deliberately, then ghusl is more beloved to me; and if he has done that, then let him seek forgiveness from Allah and not return to it.”

key_terms.تَمَّتْ صَلَاتُهُ: his salat is considered complete and valid
key_terms.غُسْلَ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ: the ritual bath associated with Friday
key_terms.نَاسِيًا: in a state of forgetfulness, without deliberate intent
key_terms.وَلَا يَعُودُ: and let him not repeat the act

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets or deliberately leaves the Friday ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling on leaving the ghusl of Friday and distinguishes between forgetfulness and deliberate omission. It indicates that the salat remains valid in the case of forgetfulness, while deliberate neglect is discouraged and followed by a recommendation to seek forgiveness and not repeat it.
